## Overview

These reports connect the source-data structure, candidate repayment-risk features, and the approved sequence for exploratory analysis.

### 1. [Data Map Report](data_map.md)

Documents each table's grain, keys, relationships, applicant coverage, and observed conflicts with the supplied data dictionary.

### 2. [Feature Report](feature_report.md)

Summarizes evidence-backed features used to assess thin-file consumer applicants and maps each feature to the exact Home Credit tables and columns available to build it.

### 3. [EDA Plan](eda_plan.md)

Orders the standing data checks and proposed analyses so that schema, key, timing, and train/test decisions are resolved before dependent summaries are produced.

## Reading order

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Data Map Report"] --> B["Feature Report"]
    B --> C["EDA Plan"]
```

Start with the data map, continue to the feature report, and finish with the EDA plan.
